items.q: What is BaZi (Four Pillars of Destiny)?
items.a: BaZi, meaning "Eight Characters" in Chinese, is an ancient astrological system that analyzes your destiny based on your birth date and time. It's called "Four Pillars" because it examines four components of your birth: the Year, Month, Day, and Hour pillars. Each pillar contains a Heavenly Stem and an Earthly Branch, creating eight characters that reveal your unique energetic blueprint.

items.q: How is BaZi different from Western astrology?
items.a: While Western astrology focuses on planetary positions at your birth time, BaZi analyzes the interplay of Five Elements (Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water) through your birth chart. BaZi provides more specific insights about your career path, wealth potential, relationships, and life cycles. It's particularly powerful for timing major life decisions and understanding your innate strengths.

BaZi has been refined over thousands of years by Chinese scholars and practitioners. Its accuracy depends on having the correct birth time—ideally within a 2-hour window. Many people find BaZi readings resonate deeply with their life experiences and provide valuable guidance for decision-making. Think of it as a tool for self-reflection and strategic planning rather than absolute prediction.

items.q: What information do I need for a reading?
items.a: You'll need your birth date and ideally your birth hour. The birth hour is important because it determines your Day Master and provides more accurate readings. If you don't know your exact birth time, you can still get a reading, but some details will be less specific. Your name and gender are optional but help personalize the reading.

items.q: What's included in the free reading?
items.a: The free reading includes your complete Four Pillars chart, dominant element analysis, personality insights based on your Day Master, lucky colors and directions, and a basic life cycle overview. It's a comprehensive introduction to BaZi that provides real value.

items.a: The Pro Reading ($9.90) adds detailed career analysis, wealth potential assessment, relationship compatibility insights, and health tendencies. The Ultimate Reading ($29.90) includes everything in Pro plus relationship compatibility report, 3-month lucky horoscope forecast, personalized lucky objects guide, extended wealth & career analysis, and year-by-year fortune timeline. items.q: Is my birth data kept private?
items.a: Absolutely. Your birth information is only used to generate your reading and is not stored on our servers after your session ends. We don't share, sell, or retain any personal data. Your reading is generated in real-time and exists only in your browser unless you choose to save it.

items.q: Do I need to create an account?
items.a: No account is required for the free reading. For paid readings, we only collect your email for delivery purposes. We don't use cookies for tracking, and there's no password to remember. It's designed to be as private and frictionless as possible.

Payments are processed through PayPal, one of the world's most secure payment platforms. We never see or store your credit card information. PayPal handles all security and fraud protection, and your financial details remain with them.

items.q: How should I interpret my reading?
items.a: Use your reading as a mirror for self-reflection. The insights about your strengths, challenges, and favorable elements can guide career choices, relationship dynamics, and timing for important decisions. Remember: BaZi reveals tendencies and potentials, not fixed outcomes. You always have free will to shape your destiny.

items.q: Can I get a reading for someone else?
items.a: Yes, you can generate readings for family members or friends using their birth information. Many people use this to understand relationship dynamics or help loved ones gain insights. Just ensure you have their permission if sharing personal birth details.

items.q: Does my reading change over time?
items.a: Your core BaZi chart (the Eight Characters) never changes—it's based on your birth and is your lifelong blueprint. However, how the energies play out evolves through your 10-year luck pillars and annual cycles. That's why we offer year-by-year analysis in the Ultimate reading to track these shifting influences.
